objectives_fil: Maipaliwanag at mailapat sa isang sitwasyon: pag-unawa sa bhwe.
objectives_en: Explain and apply in a situation: understanding bhwe.

sections.takeaway_fil: Apat na kondisyon ang kailangan sa BHWE — akreditasyon, dalawang taon sa kolehiyo, limang taon ng tuloy-tuloy na serbisyo, at satisfactory service. Kulang ang isa, hindi pa ito matutugunan.
sections.takeaway_en: BHWE needs four conditions — accreditation, two years of college, five years of continuous service, and a satisfactory record. Missing even one means it isn't met yet.

check.prompt_en: Where should BHWE requirements be confirmed?

options.fil: Sa opisyal na CSC guidance at kaukulang tanggapan.
options.en: In official CSC guidance and with the responsible office.

check.feedback_fil: Sa opisyal na CSC guidance at kaukulang tanggapan. Ipaliwanag ang dahilan gamit ang sitwasyon sa aralin.
check.feedback_en: In official CSC guidance and with the responsible office. Explain why using the lesson situation.
